findings.text: blocking: done_when (3) requires every test file importing the changed modules to pass by delta, but the recorded arms run only 2 of the 11 existing test files that import MomentGeometry or the Cerfon-Freidberg class (tests/test_equilibrium_stencil_mesh.py and tests/test_analytic_single_null.py) plus one file that imports neither changed symbol (tests/test_stencil_nulls.py); the nine omitted importers include tests/test_gs_runtime_operands.py:196, tests/test_equilibrium_forward_reference.py, tests/test_equilibrium_diagnostics.py, tests/test_biotpolysection.py, tests/test_edge_consistency.py, tests/test_edge_consistency_ids_route.py, tests/test_forward_operator_arguments.py, tests/equilibrium/test_topology_read.py and tests/test_plasma_cell_flood_families.py, so a moment-value or reference-magnitude regression in those files is unmeasured and the certificate-rows clause has no recorded check.

non-blocking: done_when (3) also asks the carrier-fixture rebuild to be measured on one row; the fragment states only that a carrier cached under the previous identity rebuilds on first use because the identity hashes nova/equilibrium/stencil_mesh.py, and neither the fragment nor any log under the run directory records a rebuild row or its wall.

non-blocking: the negative control ran at revision 71dc61b6b, whose test compared cell_sample_nodes id arrays with assert_array_equal, while the head assertion at tests/test_carrier_vertex_identity.py:156 compares vertex partitions; the discrimination is very likely preserved (618 of 2040 slot ids mismatched implies a different partition) but the head assertion itself was never shown red, and the manifest's negative_control_note calls the scratch tree 'the head tree'.

non-blocking: _representative_polygons keeps the first cell's copy of a merged corner (representative.setdefault over cells in list order), and the sampling path does the same at :500 with vertices[corner]; because the CoilSet lists the same 340 cells in a different order on each device (the run's own outside_scope entry), the stored coordinate, and therefore second_moment and sample_node_coordinates, still differ in their last bits between devices, so the carrier cache content remains device-selected even though node_number and topology now agree. The receipt omits coordinates, so the cross-device test cannot see it.

non-blocking: assert len(geometry.sample_node_coordinates) == len(np.unique(geometry.cell_sample_nodes)) compares two outputs of the code under test against each other; the implementation appends exactly one coordinate per new group id, so the relation holds by construction and cannot fail on any change to the vertex-identity rule it is placed beside.
